name: Grand Authority Sallet
desc: A fine sallet-style helmet of dark, galvanised steel. This particular style of helmet originates from the Canorian kingdoms of old, eventually becoming part of the Central Authority's armoury. Although primarily utilised by the lighter squadrons of the Central Authority Shock Corps, these helmets are highly valued by various mercenaries and brigands as well, who appreciate the design's sturdy and lightweight properties, often choosing to substitute metal for leather.
